project_type: React SPA with Vite (monorepo with web + mobile apps)
test_framework: None yet - need to add Vitest
verification_instructions: 1. Run `bun run lint` in apps/web/ - must have 0 errors. 2. Run `bun run typecheck` in apps/web/ - must pass. 3. Run `bun run build` in apps/web/ - must succeed. 4. Run `bun run test` in apps/web/ - all tests must pass.
setup_instructions: Already set up - `bun install` in apps/web/ if needed
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode. API at vidapi.ru - only /movies/latest/page-1.json returns 200 from this environment; other endpoints (trending, top-rated, tv/, search, movie detail) return 404. Tests must handle this gracefully - test what works, skip or handle gracefully what returns 404.
contribution_requirements: Use Bun (not npm/yarn). Keep files as JSX/JS (not TypeScript). No drop shadows on cards. Ghost borders 1px #E5E7EB. Rounded corners 12px on cards.
key_patterns: React functional components with hooks, React Query for data fetching, Tailwind CSS for styling with custom theme (colors: primary #2563EB, text-primary #111827, text-muted #6B7280, border #E5E7EB, canvas #F9FAFB). Layout uses react-router-dom with nested routes. API calls go through utils/api.js with localStorage caching. Inter font from Google Fonts.
directory_structure: Monorepo: /apps/web/ (Vite React SPA) and /apps/mobile/ (Expo React Native). Web app: src/app/ (pages), src/components/ (shared components), src/utils/ (api, cache, player, storage), src/hooks/ (useKeyboardShortcuts)
